text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — post-launch triage plan for the next 48h. Proposing a daily 'healing' cadence: morning triage + afternoon small-batch patch window. Thoughts?

Ethan (Eng): SGTM. We need a clear rubric mapping P0/P1/P2 -> SLA/customer-impact/usage so engineering knows what to hotfix vs backlog. Can we lock owners for each severity?

Riley (SRE): +1. Suggest rules: P0 = customer-facing regression with major loss or >5% error. P1 = high-frequency annoyance or degraded UX. P2 = low-impact bug or enhancement. Use labels: `bug/P0`, `bug/P1`, `enhancement/P2`.

Sam (Design): From design POV, for P1 let's prefer targeted UX patch if it avoids larger churn. Will prepare quick mockups for top hits.

Priya (PM): Draft process: 1) Morning triage (30m) tags P0/P1/P2 2) P0 -> oncall + eng-surgery immediately 3) P1 -> feature owner + 1 dev for same-day small-batch 4) P2 -> groomed into next-wave. Also suggest a 2-PR limit per dev/day for hotfixes to avoid context thrash.

Ethan (Eng): Also need rollback & canary rules: deploy to 5% of traffic, watch p50/p99 and error-rate for 10m, then promote or rollback. Document thresholds.

Riley (SRE): I'll own the canary flow. Proposed quick checklist we follow for each hotfix: 1) Reproduce + collect logs 2) Assign owner 3) Quick estimate (if >4h escalate) 4) Patch + unit/integration tests 5) Canary (5%) 6) Monitor metrics for 10m 7) Promote or rollback.

Priya (PM): For customer-driven asks: if customer is Dedicated/Private or has enterprise SLA, escalate to priority queue and loop CS + AM. Put customer name in the ticket title.

Sam (Design): Noted. I'll have mockups for the top two UX P1s ready by noon.

Priya (PM): @Ethan can you take ownership of the P0 route today? @Riley you'll coordinate canary and runbook entry.

Ethan (Eng): On it. Spinning a branch off `release/v1.2` and will cut a hotfix PR. ETA ~2h.

Riley (SRE): Setting canary to 5% in region-us-west, will hook alerts to #prod-alerts and create a short Runbook entry.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: hotfix/1739994310 -> canary (5%) by Ethan at 1739994410

Priya (PM): Thanks. Follow-up: Friday backlog grooming — move accepted P2s into "next-wave" with rough estimates and owner assignments. Bring 3 customer cases to the groom.

Sam (Design): Will prep the mocks and quick acceptance criteria for the UX fixes.

Ethan (Eng): Quick repro I'm seeing (sharing here): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":1}'``` getting 500 with stacktrace referencing `kv_cache.cpp:412`. Logs attached to the ticket.

Riley (SRE): Got the logs, adding to incident page and linking from the tracker. I'll watch for errors during canary window.

Priya (PM): :thumbsup: Reconvene 4pm today for a short status check. If anything blocks, DM me directly.
